scope: Native Finance payables: standalone supplier bills, Commerce fulfillment matched bills, People expense-claim linked drafts, AP journals, Money snapshots, line revisions, posted void, payable evidence, native API and desktop/mobile UI posting.

implemented.finance: post_supplier_bill_with_evidence accepts PgSupplierBillSource. commerce_fulfillment/expense_claim require a current owner witness whose invoice_id is the posted invoice. commerce_fulfillment may debit the owner goods-received/clearing liability account (control_kind none); standalone/expense claims keep the expense/asset rule.
implemented.locks: Commerce/People source locks precede Commercial authority, Finance and Files.
implemented.native_api: 3198/3199 use the shared development databases. The shared erpx_migrations checksums for 0041_leave_self_service.sql and 0293_executive_evidence.sql were aligned with the current reviewed files, resolving PRIVATE_API_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.
implemented.native_client: packages/feature-finance/src/adapters/server/native-supplier-bill.ts maps a non-JSON 4xx native reply to that status instead of masking it as 503; debug logging was removed before commit.

gates.finance.rust-supplier-bill-postgres.inte: 10/10 pass in 49.69 s (includes the new approved expense-claim source case)
new_cases: supplier_bill_posts_an_approved_expense_claim_source_with_its_owner_witness (expense 25,000 / payable 26,750 / input tax 1,750, source_type expense_claim retained)
gates.finance.generic-payments.integration: 17/17 pass when run alone; the four-suite parallel run has a 30 s timeout in the heavy 105-event inbox case under parallel load
gates.finance unit suites: 149/149 pass (command-fetch, money, navigation, report-periods, work, company-stripe)
gates.cargo test -p erpx-server-finance: all test binaries green (ERPX_TEST_ADMIN_URL and ERPX_BUN_BIN set)
gates.format: rustfmt check pass for the changed Rust files

native_http.direct_3198: POST the same native route with the finance-approver context returned 200 for invoice-1e204097c33391eec0f31629b4be8aa349e7 (journal-finance-approver-direct-20261110) and invoice-835fa75c19d4385c27a32365712a1d379145 (journal-finance-approver-direct-835-20261110).
native_http.persisted: finance_invoices status=posted, journal source_type=invoice, journal lines debit clearing/payable/input tax as expected.

legacy.native: The Finance app route calls the native supplier-bill create/edit/post/void/detail clients first. With ERPX_NATIVE_FINANCE_SUPPLIER_BILL_CONFIG set, the registered payables workflows use the native owner HTTP path.
legacy.retained: The TypeScript posting branch remains reachable only for assemblies without the native Finance supplier-bill configuration (staging/private production until a reviewed release is deployed). Named removal condition: delete the fallback once every deployed assembly has the native configuration.
legacy.expense_claim: Finance consumes an existing People expense-claim draft invoice through the People source port. Creating that invoice when finance_expenses.invoice_id is null belongs to the People payroll expenses workflow, not Finance payables.

dev_data_seeded: company_package_grants acme-co finance/supply/sales active with reviewed grant events.

hr_people/hr_engagements person-acme-finance-approver + finance_approver assignment for usr_finance_approver.
